Role & responsibilities




* Develop and optimize LLM-based solutions




*Codebase ownership




*Cloud integration




*Cross-functional collaboration with product owners, data scientists, and stakeholders




*Mentoring and providing guidance to Team




*Continuous innovation





Preferred candidate profile

*Minimum 5+ years of professional experience in building Machine Learning Models & systems

*1+ years of hands-on experience in LLMs work & Generative AI (LLM) techniques particularly prompt engineering, RAG, and agents.




*Experience in driving the engineering team toward a technical roadmap.




*Expert proficiency in programming skills in Python, Langchain , Langgraph and SQL is important.




*Understanding of Cloud services, including Azure, GCP, or AWS




*Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders and SMEs
